pr.title: Operator review confirmations answered in Telegram (flow 464)
pr.head: 6f47bf35f31c2e8c882e573b61dd4c39fcc81264

memory.query: operator confirmation cards review_complete remote card Telegram pressedBy

omissions: machine-written gdgraph/wiki data not in diff

finding.problem: CardPress/cardPressFields were introduced as the single shape for the press pair but pressedBy/pressedAt are re-declared and conditionally spread by hand in estimate.ts, learning/decisions.ts, write-land.ts, confirm-token.ts, operator-confirm-other.ts, flow/service.ts and interactive-tools.ts. operator-decisions.ts also spreads the pair twice (dead duplicate).
finding.impact: The invariant 'recorded only for confirmedVia remote-card' is enforced in one place (operatorConfirmTool, commands/operator-confirm-tools.ts:222-228) and the record shape is then free to drift per writer: a rename or a third field (for example a chat id) must be made in six or more files, and the cast in plan-confirmation.ts hides a divergence the compiler would otherwise report. The reason outside-review sites do not use the helper is dependency direction: learning/ and harness/ should not import a review/types module, so the helper is in the wrong layer for its consumers.
finding.suggested_fix: Move `CardPress` and `cardPressFields` to a neutral module (for example src/lib/card-press.ts) and re-export them from src/review/types.ts so existing imports keep working. In estimate.ts declare `PlanConfirmation = {...} & CardPress` (or have plan-confirmation.ts re-export estimate.ts's type and drop its copy and the cast). In learning/decisions.ts and write-land.ts use the shared type and `cardPressFields` instead of the hand-written optional pairs.
finding.evidence: src/review/types.ts:92-100 defines CardPress and cardPressFields. `keryx ctx rg 'pressedBy|pressedAt' src` (non-test) shows hand-written pairs at src/review/estimate.ts:199-200, src/learning/decisions.ts:33-34, src/harness/external/write-land.ts:173 and :229, src/commands/operator-confirm-other.ts:113-114, src/flow/service.ts:1681-1682, src/flow/confirm-token.ts:76-77 and :140. src/review/plan-confirmation.ts:33 has `} & CardPress;` and :~58 `return estimateReadPlanConfirmation(packageDir) as PlanConfirmation | undefined;`. Also reported by: review-clean-code-w2:F-003, review-style-w2:F-004, review-style-w3:F-001, review-style-w3:F-002, review-clean-code-w3:F-002.

finding.problem: TM-04 header (status, frozen date, task flow), the count in section 1 ('Thirteen decisions') and the tools table were not extended for review_complete, flow 457/458/464; sibling records TM-02/TM-03 do.
finding.impact: TM-04 is the document that docs/docs/cli-reference.md (lines 2773, 3212, 4367) and docs/docs/limitations.md cite for what a card does and does not prove. A reader who audits the card inventory from section 2 will believe the review close is not a card, and the stated count of operator-only decisions does not match the tools the table lists or the ones operatorConfirmSpecs() registers. No runtime effect.
finding.suggested_fix: Add rows for `review_confirm_plan` (`keryx review confirm-plan`), `review_decide_premise` (`keryx review decide-premise`) and `review_complete` (`keryx review complete`, the same gates as the CLI) to the table in section 2, change 'Thirteen' to the real count or drop the number, and in section 8 either list the three terminal commands next to the ones already named or state that they are terminal-only by TTY check and not part of touchesHumanConfirmation (src/lib/command-risk.ts has no match for confirm-plan or decide-premise).
finding.evidence: TM-04 line 15 'Thirteen keryx decisions...' and the table lines 20-35 list the card tools and omit review_confirm_plan, review_decide_premise and review_complete; line 102 (section 6a, 'Flow 464 puts the four review acts that used to need a terminal ... behind cards: `review_confirm_plan`, `review_decide_premise`, `review_waive_readiness` / `review_waive_coverage`, and `review_complete`') names them. The tools exist: src/commands/operator-confirm-review.ts (header comment lines 16-21 lists review_confirm_plan, review_decide_premise and 'Flow 464 adds review_complete'), and src/trigger/unattended.ts lines 59-71 refuses all of them by name. Section 8 (approval floor) is also unchanged: it lists `review complete --waive-coverage` and `--waive` but not plain `review complete`, `confirm-plan` or `decide-premise`. The omission of confirm-plan and decide-premise predates this PR (flows 457/459); the omission of review_complete is introduced by it. Also reported by: review-architecture-w1:F-002.

finding.problem: The list of the five Telegram-answerable review cards is hand-written in four user-facing strings (help-groups.ts, agent-commands.ts descriptions) of 330-560 characters each; no single source.
finding.impact: Low. Adding a sixth remote-answerable card means editing five places; a missed one leaves help text that names the wrong set.
finding.suggested_fix: Build the parenthesised list from one exported constant of the remote-answerable card names, or add a small test that every `review_*` name in those strings is in the registry.
finding.evidence: `keryx ctx rg -n --all 'review_confirm_plan, review_decide_premise' src` (non-test): src/standard/help-groups.ts:582 and :600, src/commands/agent-commands.ts:187 and :304. Also reported by: review-clean-code-w2:F-008, review-style-w2:F-008, review-style-w3:F-004.

finding.problem: projectRemoteRow returns early on waiting cards ahead of the flow-397 branch, so a row with a card and an unconfirmed approval drops the 'N unconfirmed' note, and the card count is truncated first on the 30-column sidebar for long topic names.
finding.impact: Low: the /remote-control status tab still prints 'Approvals not confirmed: N'. Noted because the row is the only always-visible surface and its width budget is 26 columns.
finding.suggested_fix: Compose both fragments (`${topic} · ${cards} · ${unconfirmed} unconf.`) with the existing fit(), or document that cards take precedence.
finding.evidence: remote-control-surface.ts projectRemoteRow: the `cards` branch returns before the `unconfirmed > 0` branch. Also reported by: review-logic-w4:F-005.

finding.problem: The topic-only path for a Telegram-started turn (requestApprovalForTelegramTurn) never calls operatorCards.ask/answer and has no undelivered fallback; isCard also covers schedule_* cards.
finding.impact: A review_complete or confirm-plan card raised during a Telegram-started turn, which is the main case where a remote-card answer with pressedBy is recorded, is absent from the sidebar count, the status tab and the /decisions list. The 'who pressed' view is blind exactly to the cards answered remotely from a Telegram turn. Display only; the durable record is written by the gate.
finding.suggested_fix: Put the ask/answer bookkeeping at one seam both wrappers share (a small `trackOperatorCard(meta, run)` helper in operator-confirmations.ts, or a wrapper applied to both wrappers), instead of inlining it in one branch of one closure.
finding.evidence: ctx rg for `operatorCards` in src: ask() at tui-shell.ts:6103 and :6116 only; requestApprovalForTelegramTurn spans :6028-6089 with no reference to operatorCards. Also reported by: review-logic-w4:F-006, review-security-code-w4:F-003, review-regression-w4:RG-W4-001.
